findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: five svg.h-8 wordmarks (Stripe, Notion, Linear, Vercel, Figma) have no accessible name, role or title; a screen reader gets 'Trusted by industry leaders' followed by nothing.
findings.after: <svg role="img" aria-label="Stripe">…</svg> for each (if the strip stays).

findings.evidence: Each card shows five svg stars (svg.w-5.h-5) with no text alternative; the rating exists only visually.
findings.after: <div role="img" aria-label="Rated 5 out of 5"> with the svgs aria-hidden.

findings.evidence: href '#demo' but no element with id 'demo' exists in the DOM; activating it does nothing. 'Get Started' and 'Start Free Trial' both go to '#cta', which only repeats the same buttons.
findings.after: Link to a real video (with captions) or a demo page; give the trial buttons a real signup href.

findings.evidence: focus.json: 'Get Started', 'Start Free Trial' (x2), 'Contact Sales', 'Schedule Demo' are buttons with no href or form; plus 12 footer links to '#'. Two different 'Start Free Trial' controls share a name (hero link to #cta, Pro-tier button doing nothing).
findings.after: Real links (Start Pro free trial) with plan-specific names.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose and 3.2.4 Consistent Identification.

findings.evidence: nav and footer but no main (sweep) and no skip link; the fixed floating nav (nav.fixed.top-4) is 77px tall and could cover focused section headings when jumping via #features/#pricing (no scroll-margin-top observed).
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks and 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum).

strengths: Focus order (24 stops) follows the visual order; social/brand links have text names.
not_investigated: disputed: all 1.00-1.01:1 contrast hits (nav 'Get Started', hero 'Start Free Trial', Pro tier text, CTA band) are a capture artefact: the Tailwind v3 config defining bg-cta/bg-primary/bg-text was ignored by the v4 shim, so dark fills never rendered. Re-capture with the real Tailwind runtime before reporting contrast
reflow, non-text contrast and focus-ring visibility not judged for the same reason
